name: Personalized Metal Card
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality metal, offering a sleek, durable, and premium finish.
    - Features a slim card-style design that creates a modern and eye-catching keepsake.
    - Metal thickness: 0.75mm, lightweight yet sturdy for long-lasting use.
    - Surface comes with a gloss finish, helping enhance colors and artwork with a bright and polished look.
    - Designed with rounded corners for a smoother appearance and more comfortable handling.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 2.5 x 3.5 in ~ 6.35 x 8.89 cm.
    📌 Note:  The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Supports double-sided printing, allowing custom artwork, photos, names, messages, or themed designs to be displayed on both the front and back.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as a personalized keepsake card and decorative collectible.
    - Designed for display, collection, gifting, or memory preservation.
    - Lightweight and compact, making it easy to store in wallets, card holders, memory boxes, or display stands.
    - Perfect for showcasing custom photos, messages, and meaningful themed artwork.
    - Suitable for graduations, celebrations, commemorative events, and personalized gift collections.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for graduations, birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for students, gamers, collectors, and anyone who enjoys customized keepsakes.
    - A thoughtful gift for commemorative moments, milestone achievements, and memorable occasions.
    - Great for custom collections, display pieces, and personalized surprise gifts.
    - Adds a stylish, personal, and memorable touch to every special moment 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Personalized Metal Card

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
